rationale: C03 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template. Both orders recite a statute that expressly permits presidential designation of additional agencies, state a policy reason for making the designation, and conclude with a short operative sentence designating a named agency for the statute's purposes. The sequence and phrasing are unusually close, with the later order adapting the same machinery from the Department of Justice and patent secrecy to NASA and the Assignment of Claims Act. C14 and C07 share extension language and related administrative mechanics, but neither matches the child's full statutory-designation structure as closely.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS the Assignment of Claims Act of 1940... contains the following provisions: Any contract of... any other department or agency of the United States designated by the President...
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS chapter 17 of title 35... provides in part... [an application shall be made available to] the chief officer of any other department or agency of the Government designated by the President as a defense agency of the United States.
shared_material.explanation: Each order begins by identifying and reproducing statutory language authorizing the President to add agencies by designation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: AND WHEREAS it appears that it would be in the public interest to make those provisions applicable to the National Aeronautics and Space Administration
shared_material.parent_excerpt: AND WHEREAS it appears that it would be in the interest of the national security to make the designation hereinafter described
shared_material.explanation: The child closely follows the parent's transitional finding that it is in a specified public interest to make the contemplated designation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: NOW, THEREFORE, I hereby designate the National Aeronautics and Space Administration as an agency of the United States to which such statutory provisions shall apply
shared_material.parent_excerpt: NOW, THEREFORE, I hereby designate the Department of Justice as a defense agency of the United States for the purposes of the said chapter 17
shared_material.explanation: The operative clauses use the same compact formula—“NOW, THEREFORE, I hereby designate” a named agency—while substituting the agency and governing statute.
